subject: general
question: The reservation of seats in Panchayats for SCs/STs and women comes under which Article?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 243D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 243D** of the **Indian Constitution** deals with the **reservation of seats** in every Panchayat for Scheduled Castes (SCs), Scheduled Tribes (STs), and women. 
 
• It mandates that **seats be reserved for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes** in proportion to their population in the Panchayat area.
 
• **One-third of the total seats** in every Panchayat must be reserved for **women**, including women belonging to SCs and STs.
 
• The reservation of seats for SCs, STs, and women applies to all tiers of the Panchayati Raj system (village, intermediate, and district levels).
 
• The provision ensures the **inclusion and representation** of marginalized sections of society and enhances **gender equality** at the grassroots level of governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Panchayati Raj System:**

 
 
• It is a **three-tier system** of governance at the village, intermediate, and district levels, as introduced by the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992**.
 
• The Act added **Part IX** to the Constitution, titled "The Panchayats," which includes Articles **243** to **243O**.
 
• The system aims to ensure **local self-governance** in rural areas, empowering local communities to participate in decision-making processes.
 
 
 
• **Reservation for Women:**
 
 
• **Article 243D** ensures that **one-third** of the total seats in Panchayats are reserved for women, including those from SCs and STs.
 
• This reservation is intended to promote **gender equality** and ensure women's active participation in grassroots governance.
 
 
 
• **Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes:**
 
 
• **Scheduled Castes (SCs)** and **Scheduled Tribes (STs)** are communities identified in the Constitution of India as historically disadvantaged and socially marginalized groups.
 
• Reservation in Panchayats aims to empower these communities by providing them with a platform to participate in local governance and decision-making processes.
 
 
 
• **State Election Commission:**
 
 
• The responsibility of conducting elections to Panchayats lies with the **State Election Commission**, which is established under **Article 243K** of the Constitution.
 
• The elections are held every **five years**, ensuring a regular and democratic process at the local level.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Article 243D:**

 
 
• It ensures the **political empowerment** of marginalized communities and women at the grassroots level.
 
• The reservation policy under Article 243D reflects the Indian Constitution's commitment to achieving **social justice and equality**.
 
 
 
• **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act:**
 
 
• This landmark Act was enacted in **1992** to strengthen the Panchayati Raj system in India.
 
• It provides a **constitutional status** to Panchayats and defines their structure, composition, and powers.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Local Governance:**
 
 
• Local self-governance enables citizens to participate directly in decision-making, addressing their specific needs and priorities.
 
• It enhances **democratic values**, promotes development, and improves the delivery of public services.
